subject: general
question: In 2019 , a new Rs. 20 coin was announced in the budget. The shape of this coin is ______ edged polygon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The new **Rs. 20 coin** was first announced by the **Government of India** during the **Union Budget 2019**.
 
• The shape of the **Rs. 20 coin** is a **12-edged polygon**, technically known as a **dodecagon**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 12.***
 
• This coin was officially unveiled by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** in **March 2019** as part of a new series of coins.
 
• The primary objective of the new design, including the **12-sided** shape, was to make the currency easily identifiable for **visually impaired** individuals.
 
• The coin has an **outside diameter** of **27 mm** and weighs approximately **8.54 grams**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Physical Composition**:

 
 
• The **Rs. 20 coin** is a **bi-metallic** coin, similar to the **Rs. 10 coin**.
 
• The **outer ring** is composed of **Nickel-Brass** (containing **75% Copper**, **20% Zinc**, and **5% Nickel**).
 
• The **inner center (piece)** is made of **Nickel-Brass** as well, but with a different golden-hued finish to distinguish the layers.
 
 
 
• **Design Features (Obverse)**:
 
 
• The face of the coin features the **Lion Capital of Ashoka Pillar** in the center.
 
• The words "**Satyamev Jayate**" are inscribed below the Lion Capital.
 
• The word "**Bharat**" in Hindi and "**INDIA**" in English are flank the left and right peripheries respectively.
 
 
 
• **Design Features (Reverse)**:
 
 
• The reverse side displays the denominational value "**20**" in the international numeral system.
 
• The **Rupee symbol (₹)** is placed above the numeral value.
 
• A motif of **grains** is depicted on the coin, symbolizing the **agricultural** foundation of the **Indian economy**.
 
• The **year of minting** is shown on the center-left of the reverse side.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **New Series of Coins**: Along with the **Rs. 20** denomination, the government released a new series of **Rs. 1, Rs. 2, Rs. 5, and Rs. 10** coins in **2019**.
 
• **Accessibility**: These coins were designed following the **National Institute of Design (NID)** guidelines to ensure they are **user-friendly** for the **divyangjan** (persons with disabilities).
 
• **Minting Locations**: These coins are produced at the **Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL)** mints located in **Mumbai**, **Kolkata**, **Hyderabad**, and **Noida**.
 
• **Coinage Act**: The issuance of these coins is governed by the **Coinage Act, 2011**, which gives the **Central Government** the power to design and mint coins of various denominations.
